_readme: Copy to seed/accounts.json and fill with your PayPal SANDBOX account emails (developer.paypal.com → Sandbox → Accounts). Never put live accounts here. The seed script substitutes {{RECIPIENT_n}}, {{BULK_nn}} and {{DONOR}} tokens in cases.json. Every case pays to its own account because policy P-4 flags a repeated contact. Create the business and donor accounts with a sandbox balance of at least $10,000. Judges get a copy of this file (with the sandbox passwords) in the README so they can log in as the donor and as a recipient.

FUND_BUSINESS.note: Owner of the app credentials; Payouts enabled on this account's app; balance ≥ $10,000 (Payouts draws on it)

DONOR.note: Makes the seed donations ($4,500 for the demo state) and the live $700 donation on camera; balance ≥ $10,000

RECIPIENT_1.note: C-001, log in here on camera to show the balance change

RECIPIENT_3.note: C-003 (approved by the operator on camera)

RECIPIENT_4.note: C-004 (approved by the operator on camera)

RECIPIENT_5.note: C-005 (needs_review; paid only if a judge approves it)

RECIPIENT_6.note: C-006 (auto-paid; its own account so P-4 contact dedupe does not fire against C-001)

RECIPIENT_7.note: C-007 (needs_info, never paid in the demo). Optional: any unique email works; a payout to a non-account goes UNCLAIMED

RECIPIENT_8.note: C-008 (needs_info, never paid in the demo). Optional, see RECIPIENT_7

RECIPIENT_9.note: C-009 (duplicate of C-003, never paid). Optional, see RECIPIENT_7

RECIPIENT_10.note: C-010 (flagged, never paid in the demo). Optional, see RECIPIENT_7

BULK_11.note: bulk tier-3 #3 (operator batch, parks, paid after the live donation)

BULK_12.note: bulk tier-3 #4 (operator batch, parks, paid after the live donation)
